name: Restoration capability MUST be tested/proved annually (Drills) because a backup that is never tested is not a backup.
conditionsText: Any service that backs up their data
requirementTitle: Restoration capability MUST be tested/proved annually (Drills) because a backup that is never tested is not a backup.
requirementDescription: It's not enough to create backups. The organisation must regularly prove that those backups can actually be restored successfully.
why: Because many organisations discover problems only when they need the backup.
tasks: Restoration capability MUST be tested/proved annually (Drills) because a backup that is never tested is not a backup.

actions.title: Restoration capability MUST be tested/proved annually (Drills) because a backup that is never tested is not a backup.
actions.description: Don't just create backups and assume they're fine. At least once a year, prove that you can successfully restore systems and data so that, during a real incident, recovery is reliable and predictable.
